correctness.rationale: The de Finetti reduction, explicit least-concave-majorant proof, endpoint constructions, complement lower bound, strict finite-exchangeability comparison, and proportional-threshold limits were checked analytically; a compact standard-library verifier reproduces the envelope numerically.

originality.rationale: Searches covered exact and synonymous exchangeability, mixed-binomial, concave-envelope, reliability, and concentration formulations. Closest finite-exchangeable and mixed-binomial prior art was explicitly reconciled; residual older-literature risks and incomplete access are documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact computable finite-sample effect of infinite extendibility and identifies a sharp asymptotic boundary showing that the improvement vanishes for proportional thresholds.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
